what: Outline of the process of recombinant DNA technology: Donor cell, Target DNA, Isolation of desired DNA, Enzymatic fragmentation by restriction enzyme, Vector (a plasmid or bacteriophage), Vector DNA, Joining of target DNA and cloning vector by DNA ligase, rDNA, Host bacteria, Introduction into a bacterial host cell (transformation, viral infection), Transformed host cell containing rDNA molecule, Selection identification and amplification, Cell multiplication, Protein production from cloned gene, Protein encoded by insert DNA, Protein harvesting (steps A to G)

DNA replication through polymerase chain reaction: 1 copy of desired gene, (1) Denaturation 90-98 C, DNA strands separated, (2) Annealing of primers 40-60 C, Replicating DNA strands using Taq polymerase 70-75 C, (3) 2 copies of desired gene (renaturation), First cycle completes, Second cycle to 4 copies, 2^n copies of DNA
